note: The stage 1–2 production set, as batches. ASSET_PIPELINE §4.3 step 3 requires a category to be generated as a COMPLETE batch in one session against the same golden references — never one sprite at a time — because same-session coherence is most of what keeps a set looking related. This file is the batch list; `pnpm assets:prompts` turns it into the exact text to send.
tool: God Mode AI (selected by the 2026-08-15 executive override, assets/LICENSES.md §1.5)

goldenReferences.note: ASSET_PIPELINE §4.3 step 1: 6–10 images that BECOME the definition of the style. One character, one vehicle, one table, one appliance, one ground fragment, one tree. Everything afterwards is generated with these attached as reference images. Generate these first, alone, and settle them before anything else — a golden reference that is merely acceptable makes 160 merely acceptable sprites.
